agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, March 30, 2021 - 04:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
CALL AND NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that pursuant to Government Code Section 54956, by delivery of this written notice as provided by law, the Mayor has called a special meeting of the Lomita City Council. Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20 issued on March 17, 2020, this meeting will be held via teleconference only and no physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided.
Access to the meeting will be available via URL: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86388815143 or by calling (669) 900 6833 Zoom meeting ID: 863 8881 5143
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a)
Call Meeting to Order
b)
Flag Salute
c)
Roll Call
2.
PUBLIC COMMENTS Persons wishing to speak on agenda items are requested to do so at this time. Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibits the Council from discussing or taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
3.
CONTINUATION OF 2021 GOAL SETTING DISCUSSION
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide direction.
Item SCH 3
4.
CONSIDERATION OF ESTABLISHING A COVID-19 RECOVERY AD-HOC COMMITTEE
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide direction.
5.
ADJOURNMENT I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at (310) 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.

Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.

 Lomita City Council Special Meeting Minutes
March 30, 2021

  City Manager Smoot introduced Ryder Smith and Mike Egan with Tripepi Smith to facilitate
  the goal planning discussion. Council discussed at length the eight overarching goals that
  were set at the special meeting on March 17, 2021. Mr. Smith presented the draft version of
  the goals and potential measurements and tactical deliverables were refined per the Council's
  direction. A final draft will be brought back to Council to receive and file at the next regular
  scheduled Council meeting.

4. CONSIOERATION OF ESTABLISHING A COVID.I9 RECOVERY AD-HOC COMTIITTEE
  RECOITMENDED ACTION: Discuss and provide direction

  City Manager Smoot stated that with the American Rescue Plan Ad of 2021 there is a
  significant amount of funding that will be allocated to local agencies. The funding is broad in
  its allowable uses as it can be used for cost recovery, revenue losses, and specific
  infrastructure categories. ln preparation for that it would be helpful to have a committee to
  make recommendations regarding the distribution of those funds to our local residents and
  businesses. Council MemberWaite, MayorWaronek, and Council Member Uphoff expressed
  interest in participating in the committee. After brief discussion, Council Member Waite
  defened to Council Member Uphoff.

  Mayor Pro Tem Segawa made a motion, seconded by Council Member Waite to appoint
  Mayor Waronek and Council Member Uphoff to the COVID-19 Recovery Ad-hoc Committee.

  MOTION CARRIED by the following vote

  AYES: Council Members: Gazeley, Uphoff, Waite, Mayor Pro Tem Segawa, and Mayor
  Waronek
  NOES: None
  ABSENT: None
